warnings: All five PDFs are marked as synthetic training replicas and not official ACORD forms; the footer says not to use them for insurance placement.

The ACORD 125 lists 3 declared premises and states that the attached SOV contains 4 buildings. Both counts are preserved; reconcile the additional SOV location against the full SOV and location schedule.
ACORD 125 location 01 is 1000 Sample Commerce Parkway, while ACORD 140 page 2 SOV row 01 uses 2000 Sample Commerce Pkwy. Preserve both source addresses; confirm the location mapping.

The ACORD 140 received copy (received 10/24/2026) shows $12,500,000 for the page 1 Building amount and $22,800,000 for SOV row 02. The resubmitted copy (received 10/26/2026) changes the page 1 Building amount to $14,800,000 and SOV row 02 to $14,800,000; SOV row 01 remains $12,500,000. Both source versions are retained.

In the resubmitted ACORD 140, the page 1 premises record remains premises 01 / location A02-LOC-01, while the updated $14,800,000 Building amount equals SOV row 02 and not SOV row 01. Do not infer a location reassignment; confirm the intended property/location mapping.

The ACORD 130 page 2 worksheet has 12 visible classification rows (5 for A02-LOC-01, 5 for A02-LOC-02, and 2 for A02-LOC-03) whose estimated payroll values total $11,764,000. The same page states $17,300,000 for both payroll declared on the application and payroll in the supporting class schedule, with $0 variance. The visible rows therefore fall short of the stated payroll total by $5,536,000; the remaining classifications/rows are not shown in this PDF.
All 12 visible manual-premium cells in the ACORD 130 page 2 classification table are blank; they are retained as null rather than calculated or inferred.

The ACORD 130 experience modification shown on the application is 0.98 and the factor used in the draft quote is 0.98; the prior policy factor is 1.01. The form marks the variance status as ALIGNED. These source values are retained as displayed.
The ACORD 126 temperature-sensitive cargo row references A03 and an A03 simulated peak load of $750,000. It is preserved verbatim and is not attributed to A02.

The ACORD 125 checklist labels the sprinkler service/inspection certificate as “Attached / not requested in this synthetic account”; the ACORD 130 page 4 says “No purposely omitted item in this synthetic control.” The source does not mark a missing sprinkler certificate in these A02 forms.
ACORD 125 marks Business Auto as requested, but no separate Business Auto application is among the five uploaded PDFs.

The PDFs refer to supporting XLSX/TXT documents (loss runs, fleet/driver schedule, Statement of Values, WC rating/experience modification support, broker operations narrative, and external public-source notes). Those separate files were not included in this upload and are not extracted here.
Currency codes were not printed explicitly; ISO currency values are left null instead of inferred from the dollar sign.
